def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix species label variants (Adeile -> Adelie, Gentto -> Gentoo, case variants)
    species_map = {'adelie': 'Adelie', 'adeile': 'Adelie', 'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap', 'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'gentto': 'Gentoo'}
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    lower = df['species'].str.lower()
    df['species'] = lower.map(species_map).fillna(df['species'])
    # fix island label variants (biscoe -> Biscoe)
    island_map = {'biscoe': 'Biscoe', 'dream': 'Dream', 'torgersen': 'Torgersen'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    lower_i = df['island'].str.lower()
    df['island'] = lower_i.map(island_map).fillna(df['island'])
    # body_mass_g is text with commas and unit error (e.g. 3650000 mg instead of g)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # out_of_range: values >6500 are in mg, convert to g
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    # flipper_length_mm may be stored as text
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    # average body mass for each species
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species'])
    # ensure numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items() if pd.notna(k)}
